name: emoji
title: Emoji
description: An emoji picker: a grid of glyphs by category, recently used first, searched by name, keyword and :shortcode:. Copies or pastes the emoji (with your skin tone), or copies its :shortcode:.
author: pal

settings.label: Paste on Enter

settings.description: Off, Enter copies and ⌘Enter pastes. Pasting needs Accessibility on macOS.

store.tagline: An emoji grid by category, recently used first; copy or paste one, or its :shortcode:.
features: Every emoji in the bundled list as a grid, Recently used first (the last 24 you copied or pasted), then Unicode's groups from Smileys & Emotion to Flags
Search by name, keyword or shortcode: `thumbs`, `celebrate`, `:thumbs_up:`
`Enter` copies the emoji, `cmd+enter` pastes it into the app in front; `paste_by_default` swaps the two
A skin tone setting applied to the 329 emoji that take one, in the tile, on copy and on paste
Live with a 30 s ttl, so the recents follow what you used

screenshots.caption: The grid: Recently used, then Smileys & Emotion and the other groups
Searching by keyword narrows the tiles across every group
